fields.statement: At c30d3cb2 ran `go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run Inbox -v`: all seven inbox tests PASS, including TestInboxGateQuestionsBudget (generated 3000-node log with an index; plan run at its gate with six open questions over three planned change sets). It asserts every question's statement, zero full-log decodes (countingCtx), each change set's model built at most once and every planned one (own plus three) exactly once via the builtModel hook in writeIndex.buildModel, no index catch-up decode after the read (LastCatchUp Decoded 0, not rebuilt), and the 1 s budget. Read the diff: inboxGateRead opens the worktree's index (index.DefaultPath) with an ix.models memo plus a local per-call modelOf memo. Mutation check in a scratch copy with both memos removed: the budget test FAILS with planned change sets folded 2-7 times, so the attempt 1 finding (no fold-count assertion) is fixed.
